items.title: How MuleSoft Rebuilt a Live Observability Platform While Migrating 39 Petabytes of Customer Data
items.summary: By Atul Singh and Shashi Chinthakindi. In our Engineering Energizers Q&A series, we spotlight the engineers tackling Salesforce’s toughest technical challenges. Today, we feature Atul Singh, Principal Architect at Salesforce, whose team faced a seemingly impossible mission: replace MuleSoft’s aging observability platform, migrate 39 petabytes of telemetry, and keep production monitoring operational throughout the transformation.
